== On Callandor ==
In the 'Avalon parallels', someone has put that Callandor was forged in Tar Valon, but I'm sure it was built before the 'Time of Madness' and though I think it was ambiguous in the Rhuidean trial, I'm sure it's what was left of Paaran Disen.[[User:Lightningbarer|Lightningbarer]] 21:43, December 29, 2009 (UTC)

: What do you mean? That Tar Valon is what was left of Paaran Disen, or Rhuidean what was left of Paaran Disen? About Tar Valon I'm sure it isn't, in EotW prolouge Lews Therin creates the island, and IIRC Rhuidean was build when the Aiel arrived there. But I'm nut sure about it.
:
One of Rand's ancestors saw it being sent off during the Breaking before the Aiel were sent away, but there was no indication as to where it was forged. And Tar Valon was built after the Breaking, by Ogiers with AS help (I think); there was no references saying Tar Valon survived the Breaking. Thus it would be a tenuous link at best to say Callandor was forged in Tar Valon. I vote delete that line. [[User:Astro Droid|Astro Droid]] 01:26, August 23, 2011 (UTC)

:This seems unlikely. In the question of the week article on Tor.com, Jordan said that TV has a population of around 500,000, whilst Caemlyn and Cairhien were more around 300,000. If Caemlyn were to overtake Tar Valon due to refugee problems, that would be a temporary change and should be noted as such. If you can provide the exact chapter in WH or KoD where this is noted, that would be helpful.--[[User:Werthead|Werthead]] 14:21, June 9, 2012 (UTC)
